metadata.source: World Bank — GDP (current LCU), indicator NY.GDP.MKTP.CN
metadata.notes: Kenya nominal GDP, current prices, in Kenyan shillings (raw KES, not billions). Authoritative World Bank actuals; the latest published year is 2024 (World Bank publishes nominal GDP with a ~1-2 year lag). This file is the SINGLE in-repo source of truth for the nominal-GDP denominator and is used (a) by bootstrap on startup and (b) as the fallback when the live World Bank fetch is unavailable, so we never inject a hardcoded estimate. The live national_gdp seeding domain overlays current World Bank values on top of this. NOTE: the HEADLINE debt-to-GDP ratio is sourced from the IMF GGXWDG_NGDP series (vintage-consistent, same-year debt and GDP) rather than computed by dividing current debt by a lagged GDP year.
